Reasoning: The stage is a conjunctive reorientation-in-place while continuing to hold the can. object_grasped represents that the can remains physically held and the gripper is not intentionally opened. freeze_position keeps the currently grasped can_center_frame origin at its start-of-stage world position within 0.01 m. axis_align rotates the gripped can until its local -y long/upright axis is codirectional with world +z within the requested 0.05 rad, without constraining roll about that same axis. The API cannot explicitly encode preserving the exact start-of-stage rigid transform between panda_fingertip and can_center_frame, individual finger joint positions, or finger squeeze/contact effort feedback; these are represented only partially by object_grasped and the gripper_closed condition.
